newsitem.title: USA: NetVantage sets warrant redemption date.
newsitem.headline: NetVantage sets warrant redemption date.

text.p: NetVantage Inc Tuesday said it set October 3 as the redemption date for its Class A Warrants.

Each Class A Warrant entitles the holder to purchase, at an exercise price of $6.21, 1.05 shares of common stock and a Class B Warrant. All Class A Warrants not exercised prior to the redemption date will be redeemed by the company for $0.05 each. No fractional shares will be issued.
In resumed mid-afternoon trade following a halt for news, shares were off 1 at 10.

With respect to any fraction of a share called for upon the exercise of warrants, the company will pay to the warrant holder an amount of cash equal to such fraction multiplied by the current market value of such fractional share, determined as the average of the last reported bid and asked prices reported by the NASDAQ SmallCap Market on the last business day prior to the date of the exercise of the warrant.
In accordance with the warrant agreement, the Class A Warrants will be null and void after the redemption date, except for the right of the holder to receive the $0.05 redemption price.
